title: Editor E6 slice: move, space and add blocks on the canvas's real document
detail:
Split from PROG-E6 on 2026-11-16. PROG-E5B put a real Space page draft under the staff, EDITOR_CANVAS-gated /pages/canvas, but only a block's fields could be edited: layer order was local, nothing could be added, spacing was not there. This slice adds four things on that same document, through that same draft write. Dark; the switch default is unchanged.

Premise re-tested (ADR-1082): the node document already stores everything needed. A Space page is rows, each row is columns, each column a stack of blocks (lib/entity-blocks/node-tree.ts), and a block's spacing is already three named steps on its style (`style.mt`, `style.pad`, `style.mb`, sanitized to fixed words by sanitizeBlockStyle). So no document shape change, no migration and no SQL.

What now works. (1) Saved reorder: a move in the layer list is sent as a slot (row, column, place) and stored in the draft. (2) Nested layer tree: LayerList, extended and not replaced, draws rows, columns and blocks when given a tree; a press-and-hold drag reorders inside a column, and Up, Down and Alt+Arrow also carry a block past the end of its column into the next column or row, an empty column included, so every place on the page is reachable with no drag. Without a tree it is the flat list it was. (3) Spacing handles: the selected block carries three handles in the canvas frame (space above, padding, space below). Each is a slider over the document's named steps; a drag is counted in steps and the arrow keys walk them, so no length leaves the handle. (4) Presets-first inserter: five presets (a block with starting words) are on show, the blank blocks sit behind one more tap; either lands under the selected block. The blank list is the Space page builder's own palette narrowed to the blocks a person writes; a block at its per-page limit stays listed, switched off, with the reason.

One write path: all three changes ride saveCanvasNodeDraft (app/(main)/pages/canvas/document-actions.ts), the single action PROG-E5B shipped, as an optional `change` beside the field values. Same door (switch, staff, resolveSpaceManageAccess, render path), same base (revision and fingerprint), same plan (planCanvasDraftWrite, now also applyCanvasChange) and the same guarded update (writeSpacePreferencesAtRevision). The server parses a spacing step as one of six fixed words and resolves an insert from an id it owns (lib/builder/canvas-presets.ts); the tab never sends a block type's content. A move or an insert hands the tab the page's shape again (canvasDocumentParts), so the tab never rebuilds a block's controls. A full column or a block at its limit is refused, never made room for by dropping a block. The client queue (use-canvas-document.ts) sends shape changes in order ahead of waiting field edits, shows a move and a spacing step at once, puts a refused move back, and keeps what is being typed in a block when a move lands.

Also fixed, found taking the pictures: the canvas frame (PROG-E4B, canvas-viewport-shell.tsx) stayed EMPTY in a real browser. The frame is in the server's markup and finished loading before React was listening for its load event, so nothing was ever drawn in it. The shell now uses a frame document that is already loaded when it takes hold of the element.

VERIFIED: unit tests for the tree and spacing model, the presets and the structural changes on the stored document, the action end to end with the data layer mocked (move, spacing, insert, stale tab, read-only door, refused input), the client queue under jsdom, and the three controls driven by click, key and pointer under jsdom. The probe runs the shipped action and loader with only framework, auth and database replaced. Pictures at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 px from a local dev server rendering the real canvas components on a fixture document built by the real server code (a throwaway page, not committed), in /mnt/project-files/editor/e6b/. NOT VERIFIED: the live route with a signed-in staff account and a database (this box has neither), so no save was made from a browser and the PostgREST revision filter has still not run against Postgres; no finger on a real phone; the frame fix has no unit test (jsdom does not load a srcdoc frame), it was confirmed in Chromium both ways.

Known limits, stated plainly: a drag only reorders inside one column (across columns is Up, Down or the keyboard); the handles sit beside the frame's plain word preview of the block and their size is an editor's sketch, not the page's exact spacing; the frame still draws only the selected block, not the page; the sections that show a Space's live data (About, Offerings, Events) cannot be added from the canvas, because whether a Space may place one depends on its data, which the Space page builder decides; rows and columns themselves cannot be added, removed or reordered here; a block cannot be removed here; there is no undo. The whole-blob write limit recorded on PROG-E5B applies to these writes unchanged.

verify.note: Runs the shipped draft action and canvas read with only framework, auth and database replaced (the database stand-in compares the revision in the write). Fails on main: no layer tree, no structural change on the draft action, no presets. Passes when a move is saved to the draft and survives a reload, a stale tab is refused, a spacing step is stored only as a named step, a preset inserts under the selected block ahead of blank blocks, a foreign id is refused, and nothing writes with the switch off, for non-staff or for a read-only preview.
